context: A toy causal system for validating metadata-only causal discovery runs. Study effort affects exam score, and exam score affects course pass status.

variables.name: StudyEffort
variables.description: A pre-exam input behavior. Higher effort tends to improve later exam performance.

variables.name: ExamScore
variables.description: An intermediate measured performance variable. It is affected by study effort and influences the final course outcome.

variables.name: PassCourse
variables.description: A final binary outcome. It is downstream of exam performance rather than a direct cause of preparation.
